+// Enough to keep Postgres busy, small enough to hold in memory.
+const CURSOR_BATCH = 2_000
 
 export type Filter = {
   accountId: string
@@ -16,14 +18,20 @@ function rowsFor(filter: Filter) {
     .orderBy('issued_at', 'asc')
 }
 
-export async function buildCsv(filter: Filter): Promise<string> {
-  const rows = []
-  for (let page = 0; ; page++) {
-    const batch = await rowsFor(filter).limit(PAGE_SIZE).offset(page * PAGE_SIZE)
-    if (batch.length === 0) break
-    rows.push(...batch)
-  }
-  return BOM + [HEADER, ...rows.map(formatRow)].join('\r\n')
+/** The invoices as CSV, a line at a time, however many there are. */
+export function csvStream(filter: Filter): Readable {
+  const cursor = rowsFor(filter).cursor(CURSOR_BATCH)
+  let first = true
+  const lines = new Transform({
+    objectMode: true,
+    writableHighWaterMark: CURSOR_BATCH,
+    transform(row, _enc, done) {
+      const head = first ? BOM + HEADER + '\r\n' : ''
+      first = false
+      done(null, head + formatRow(row) + '\r\n')
+    },
+  })
+  return Readable.from(cursor).pipe(lines)
 }
